title: Recursion: base case and the call stack

objectives.text: Write a recursive method with a base case and a recursive step that moves toward it
Trace the call stack of a recursive method, frame by frame, including the returns
Explain why a missing or unreachable base case ends in StackOverflowError

Program outputs and javac messages shown on the page and produced by the practice editor were compared with a local JDK 17.0.12 javac/java run on 2026-10-16, not with JDK 25; the cited SE 25 rules are unchanged for these constructs, but a JDK 25 run has not been recorded.
The practice editor stops recursion at about 600 frames to stay responsive; a real JVM stack is usually deeper (it depends on the thread stack size), but unbounded recursion still overflows it.
